meta.title: AME — Sheet Music and Software
meta.description: Arranged sheet music on Piascore, software on GitHub. A place that collects what I publish.

hero.title: Sheet music and software.
hero.description: I sell my sheet music arrangements on Piascore and publish the tools I build on GitHub. This site keeps them in one place.

music.title: Sheet music
music.description: I publish sheet music on Piascore.

software.title: Software
software.description: Tools and libraries published on GitHub.

items.aiReview: A review foundation that runs static analysis and AI review on pull requests and pre-commit.
items.designSkills: UI/UX and typography rules for TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, packaged as agent Skills.
items.agentChat: A local development environment for using OpenCode from the browser.
items.aiSandbox: A Docker sandbox for running Claude Code and OpenCode inside a container.
items.compression: A video compression script built on FFmpeg.
items.notoFonts: A script that replaces Windows system fonts with Noto Sans.
items.notation: A transcription assistant that turns audio into scores and MIDI. Development is paused for now.
items.markdownDesign: A CSS collection for Markdown Preview Enhanced and Marp.
items.atcoderLibrary: The C# library I use on AtCoder.

writing.title: Writing
writing.description: Notes on what I looked into, tried, and thought about, written on Note and Qiita. The articles are in Japanese.

about.title: About
about.lead: I live in Kawasaki, Kanagawa. I work as an IT engineer and also make music.
about.p1: I have spent about 13 years as an IT engineer, working on business systems and development infrastructure. In recent years I have been publishing the tools I build on GitHub.
about.p2: Music started as a hobby, through piano and bass. Since 2026 I have been arranging and selling scores.
about.p3: This site exists to keep the things I publish in one place.

footer.tagline: Sheet music and software, kept in one place
